hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress, uniformly weak or negative composites, and elevated expected shortfall warrant defensive sizing. Most signals are flat with low-to-moderate conviction; avoid treating them as actionable longs. ETC/USD is especially fragile: its long signal is unsupported by a zero price, zero volatility, and zero liquidity/institutional data, so it should be effectively suppressed. BCH/USD is also fragile given the strongly negative composite, alpha, institutional score, and liquidity rank. BTC/USD is the strongest relative risk anchor but remains exposed to the stressed regime.
